senses.gloss: Pināka, the staff or bow of Śiva. § 581 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 62, 2776 (ºm iva Rudrasya, sc. the mace of Bhīmasena): 63, 2797 (do.).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 90, †4661 (Harāmbupākhaṇḍalavittagoptṛbhiḥ Pºpāśāśanisāyakottamaiḥ|surottamair apy avishahyam ardituṃ, sc. the diadem of Arjuna); 91, †4790 (añjalikaṃ…Pº-Nārāyaṇacakrasannibhaṃ).-§ 701b (Bhava-Bhārgavasamāgama): XII, 290, 10676 (ānatenātha śūlena pāṇinā 'mitatejasā Pºm iti covāca śūlam Ugrāyudhaḥ (i.e. Śiva) prabhuḥ).--§ 730g (Upamanyu): XIII, 14, 849 (dhanuḥ Pºm iti vikhyātaṃ).--§ 768b (UmāMaheśvarasaṃv.): XIII, 140, 6386; 141, 6396.

Pinākin^1, a Rudra. § 108 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 66, 2566 (among the sons of Sthāṇu).--§ 191 (Arjuna): I, 123, 4826 (present at the birth of Arjuna).--§ 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7586.--§ 770 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7090.
